The protocol modules of both (src/protocol/) are generated from the X11 protocol
descriptions of xcb-proto 1.17.0, which the x11rb repository vendors in xcb-proto-1.17.0
(commit 1b73245 of https://github.com/psychon/x11rb, the commit of both releases). Their
copyright lines and licences, as the files state them:

MIT License (MIT):
- src/composite.xml: Copyright (c) 2006, Oracle and/or its affiliates.

- src/composite.xml: Copyright (C) 2004 Josh Triplett. All Rights Reserved.
